trace.name: org.overview_teams
trace.cypher: MATCH (t:Team) OPTIONAL MATCH (t)-[:OWNS]->(c:Component) WITH t, collect(DISTINCT c.name) AS components OPTIONAL MATCH (d:Dev)-[:MEMBER_OF]->(t) RETURN t.name AS name, components, collect(DISTINCT d.name) AS devs ORDER BY name

trace.name: org.overview_projects
trace.cypher: MATCH (p:Project) OPTIONAL MATCH (p)-[:INCLUDES]->(c:Component) RETURN p.name AS name, p.repo AS repo, p.started_at AS started_at, collect(c.name) AS components ORDER BY started_at

trace.name: org.overview_counts
trace.cypher: OPTIONAL MATCH (s:Session) WITH count(s) AS sessions OPTIONAL MATCH (l:Session {status:'live'}) WITH sessions, count(l) AS live_sessions OPTIONAL MATCH (m:Solution) WITH sessions, live_sessions, count(m) AS solutions OPTIONAL MATCH (q:Question) WITH sessions, live_sessions, solutions, count(q) AS questions OPTIONAL MATCH ()-[r:REUSED]->() RETURN sessions, live_sessions, solutions, questions, coalesce(sum(r.tokens_saved), 0) AS tokens_saved
